description: This Java class defines configuration management for JWT subject issuers, including methods for creating configurations from different sources, retrieving issuer-specific configs, and handling protocol prefixes.

classes.name: JwtSubjectIssuersConfig
classes.description: Immutable configuration class for managing JWT subject issuer configurations, supporting retrieval and creation from OAuth configurations.

methods.name: fromJwtSubjectIssuerConfigs
methods.description: Creates an instance from an iterable of JwtSubjectIssuerConfig objects, using default protocol.

methods.name: fromOAuthConfig
methods.description: Creates an instance from an OAuthConfig object, merging default and extension issuer configs.

methods.name: getConfigItem
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a specific issuer, if available.

methods.name: getConfigItems
methods.description: Returns configuration items associated with a specific SubjectIssuer.
